name: @tradrl/observability
description: Observability contracts (Work Order T043): the TelemetryRecord discriminated union (metric | trace-span | log) — every variant tenant/project-scoped (L12), actor-ref'd, observed-seam-ref'd over the platform's EXISTING event seams, explicitly recordedAt'd (injected instants only) and content-addressed from the byte-stable canonical form; the structural mirrors (D-004 — never imports) of the four merged seams this layer observes (agent-os MessageEnvelope/KernelOperation, execution-authority GatewayAuditRecord, control-plane ProjectAuditEntry + PROJECT_AUDIT_OPERATION_KINDS, event-store StorableEvent) with src/interop.test.ts as the drift trip wire; and the credential-opacity trip wire run over EVERY emitted record (a credential VALUE under a credential-shaped key anywhere is the typed credential_value_present error; a 'cred:' ref is fine).
